description.en:
Basic Attack

Yuanwu performs up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG.

Heavy Attack

Yuanwu consumes STA to attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Yuanwu consumes STA to launch a Mid-air Plunging Attack, dealing Electro DMG.

Dodge Counter

Use Basic Attack after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Yuanwu melakukan hingga 5 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Electro DMG.

Heavy Attack

Yuanwu mengonsumsi STA untuk menyerang target, memberikan Electro DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Yuanwu mengonsumsi STA untuk melancarkan Mid-air Plunging Attack, memberikan Electro DMG.

Dodge Counter

Gunakan Basic Attack setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Electro DMG.

description.en:
Thunder Wedge

Yuanwu summons Thunder Wedge, dealing Electro DMG, and forms a Thunder Field centered on the Thunder Wedge. Thunder Wedge lasts for 12s.
Forte Circuit Rumbling Spark and Resonance Liberation Blazing Might will immediately detonate Resonance Skill Thunder Wedge on the field, dealing Electro DMG, considered as Resonance Skill DMG.

Thunder Field

The active character gains the effects below when in the Thunder Field: a Coordinated Attack from Resonance Skill Thunder Wedge is triggered when attacks hit a target, dealing Electro DMG. This can be triggered once every 1.2s. The effect lasts for 1.5s.
description.id:
Thunder Wedge

Yuanwu memanggil Thunder Wedge yang memberikan Electro DMG, dan membentuk Thunder Field yang berpusat pada Thunder Wedge. Thunder Wedge bertahan selama 12 dtk.
Forte Circuit Rumbling Spark dan Resonance Liberation Blazing Might akan langsung meledakkan Resonance Skill Thunder Wedge yang ada di lapangan, memberikan Electro DMG, dianggap sebagai Resonance Skill DMG.

Thunder Field

Karakter aktif mendapat efek berikut saat berada di dalam Thunder Field: Coordinated Attack dari Resonance Skill Thunder Wedge terpicu saat serangan mengenai target, memberikan Electro DMG. Dapat terpicu sekali setiap 1,2 dtk. Efek bertahan selama 1,5 dtk.

description.en: Awaken the power of thunder and provide Forte Circuit Lightning Infused status to all characters on a nearby team for 10s, then perform a powerful blow that deals Electro DMG.
description.id: Membangkitkan kekuatan petir dan memberikan status Forte Circuit Lightning Infused kepada seluruh karakter di tim sekitar selama 10 dtk, lalu melancarkan pukulan dahsyat yang memberikan Electro DMG.

description.en: The DMG multiplier of Resonance Skill Thunder Uprising is increased by 40%, and its reduction efficiency of enemy Vibration Strength is enhanced.
description.id: Pengali DMG Resonance Skill Thunder Uprising meningkat sebesar 40%, dan efisiensi pengurangan Vibration Strength musuh meningkat.

description.en: The ranges of the Resonance Skills Thunder Field and Thunder Uprising are greatly expanded. When switched off the field during combat, if "Readiness" is not full, Yuanwu will automatically leave 1 Resonance Skill Thunder Wedge in place.
description.id: Jangkauan Resonance Skill Thunder Field dan Thunder Uprising diperluas secara signifikan. Saat berganti keluar lapangan dalam pertempuran, jika "Readiness" belum penuh, Yuanwu akan otomatis meninggalkan 1 Resonance Skill Thunder Wedge di tempat.

description.en: Attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.

Rumbling Spark

When "Readiness" is full, hold Resonance Skill to consume all "Readiness" and cast Rumbling Spark, dealing Electro DMG and entering the Lightning Infused state.

Thunder Uprising

When "Readiness" is full, Resonance Skill Thunder Wedge will be replaced with Thunder Uprising, dealing Electro DMG.

Lightning Infused

The character in Lightning Infused state has a greatly increased resistance to interruption.
When Yuanwu is in this state:
-Basic Attacks: Hit targets in a larger range, reduce enemy Vibration Strength with increased efficiency.
-Heavy Attacks: Have increased attack speed, reduce enemy Vibration Strength with increased efficiency.
-Dodge Counters: Have increased attack speed, reduce enemy Vibration Strength with increased efficiency.
-Use Basic Attack within 3s after casting a Heavy Attack or a successful Counterattack to cast Thunderweaver, dealing Electro DMG, considered as Basic Attack DMG.
-Does not recover "Readiness".

Readiness

Yuanwu can hold up to 100 "Readiness".
When Resonance Skill Thunder Wedge is on the field, Yuanwu gains 6 "Readiness" every second, even when he is not the active character;
When Resonance Skill Thunder Wedge hits a target with a Coordinated Attack, Yuanwu gains 5 "Readiness".
description.id:
Rumbling Spark

Saat "Readiness" penuh, tahan Resonance Skill untuk mengonsumsi seluruh "Readiness" dan melancarkan Rumbling Spark, memberikan Electro DMG dan memasuki kondisi Lightning Infused.

Thunder Uprising

Saat "Readiness" penuh, Resonance Skill Thunder Wedge akan diganti dengan Thunder Uprising, memberikan Electro DMG.

Lightning Infused

Karakter dalam kondisi Lightning Infused memiliki ketahanan yang jauh lebih tinggi terhadap interupsi.
Saat Yuanwu dalam kondisi ini:
-Basic Attack: Mengenai target dalam jangkauan lebih luas, mengurangi Vibration Strength musuh dengan efisiensi lebih tinggi.
-Heavy Attack: Kecepatan serangan meningkat, mengurangi Vibration Strength musuh dengan efisiensi lebih tinggi.
-Dodge Counter: Kecepatan serangan meningkat, mengurangi Vibration Strength musuh dengan efisiensi lebih tinggi.
-Gunakan Basic Attack dalam 3 dtk setelah melancarkan Heavy Attack atau Counterattack yang berhasil untuk melancarkan Thunderweaver, memberikan Electro DMG, dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG.
-Tidak memulihkan "Readiness".

Readiness

Yuanwu dapat menyimpan hingga 100 "Readiness".
Saat Resonance Skill Thunder Wedge ada di lapangan, Yuanwu mendapat 6 "Readiness" setiap detik, bahkan saat ia bukan karakter aktif;
Saat Resonance Skill Thunder Wedge mengenai target dengan Coordinated Attack, Yuanwu mendapat 5 "Readiness".

description.en: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.
description.id: Berpeluang menghasilkan hidangan spesial saat memasak.

description.en: Yuanwu unleashes thunderbolts in an area centered around the skill target, greatly reducing the Vibration Strength of enemies upon impact.
description.id: Yuanwu melepaskan sambaran petir di area yang berpusat pada target skill, secara signifikan mengurangi Vibration Strength musuh saat terkena.

description.en: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.
description.id: Saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Resonator dapat melancarkan Tune Break pada target.

description.en: When Yuanwu is in Forte Circuit's Lightning Infused state, his Basic Attack Speed is increased by 20%, and his Heavy Attack Speed is increased by 20%.
description.id: Saat Yuanwu dalam kondisi Lightning Infused milik Forte Circuit, Basic Attack Speed meningkat sebesar 20%, dan Heavy Attack Speed meningkat sebesar 20%.

description.en: Intro Skill Thunder Bombardment additionally recovers 15 Resonance Energy for Yuanwu.
description.id: Intro Skill Thunder Bombardment memulihkan tambahan 15 Resonance Energy untuk Yuanwu.

description.en: When the Coordinated Attacks of Resonance Skill's Thunder Wedge hits a target, the damage is additionally increased by 20% of Yuanwu's DEF.
description.id: Saat Coordinated Attack Resonance Skill Thunder Wedge mengenai target, damage meningkat tambahan sebesar 20% DEF Yuanwu.

description.en: When casting Resonance Liberation Blazing Might, the on-field character will gain a Shield equal to 200% of Yuanwu's DEF for 10s.
description.id: Saat melancarkan Resonance Liberation Blazing Might, karakter di lapangan mendapat Shield sebesar 200% DEF Yuanwu selama 10 dtk.

description.en: When Resonance Skill Thunder Wedge is on the field, Yuanwu's Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus is increased by 50%.
description.id: Saat Resonance Skill Thunder Wedge ada di lapangan, Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus Yuanwu meningkat sebesar 50%.

description.en: All team members nearby within the range of Resonance Skill Thunder Wedge will gain a 32% DEF increase, lasting 3s.
description.id: Seluruh anggota tim di sekitar dalam jangkauan Resonance Skill Thunder Wedge mendapat peningkatan DEF sebesar 32% selama 3 dtk.
